bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
pg=deploy-postgres-1
sql="SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND max(r.paid_message_id)=4718 AND max(r.status)='sent' AND max(l.status)='published' AND max(l.price_stars)=10 THEN 'DIRECT_NATIVE_4718_READBACK_PASS' ELSE 'DIRECT_NATIVE_4718_READBACK_FAIL' END FROM videobot_post_receipts r JOIN videobot_listings l ON l.listing_id=r.listing_id WHERE r.listing_id='directpaidprotected_20261123';"
out="$(docker exec -e "SQL=$sql" "$pg" sh -c 'psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d videobot -At -c "$SQL"')";echo "$out";test "$out" = DIRECT_NATIVE_4718_READBACK_PASS
sql2="SELECT COUNT(*) FROM videobot_post_receipts WHERE paid_message_id IN (4691,4701,4714,4715,4717) AND status='sent';"
out2="$(docker exec -e "SQL=$sql2" "$pg" sh -c 'psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d videobot -At -c "$SQL"')";echo "ORIGINAL_PAID_POST_RECEIPTS=$out2";test "$out2" = 5
